variants.headline: Money in hand, no food to buy
variants.body: Shops and farms are sold out of food, leaving people with money unable to buy meals. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Shops and farms sell out
variants.body: People have money for food but cannot buy it because shops and farms are sold out. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Food shortage defeats the buyer
variants.body: Food is unavailable to buyers even with money in hand: shops and farms are sold out. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
